raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Reject non-inline image sources before local base64 decoding with a clear error for both
OpenAI-compatible proxy requests and direct `ArealOpenAI` calls. Clarify the inline-only
contract in docstrings and validation messages while preserving URL forwarding for
tokenizer-only clients.

## Related Issue

Fixes #1770

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [x] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the
  [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [x] Documentation updated (function docstrings and validation messages; no docs site
  changes)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [x] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [ ] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

## Additional Context

- `python -m pytest tests/experimental/openai/test_vlm_trajectory.py -q`: **28 passed**.
- `pre-commit run --all-files`: **passed**.

Tests cover valid inline PNG/JPEG images, rejection of unsupported sources before
decoding, invalid image data, and unchanged HTTP(S) URL extraction.

GPU/distributed and live proxy integration tests were not run in this CPU test
environment. No docs site build was needed for docstring-only documentation changes.
